sources_note: 來源與日期逐篇列明。公司公告按原文歸因，開放範圍以可核對的資料為準。
sources_note_en: Each story lists its source and date. Company announcements are attributed and availability follows the documented scope.
thesis: AI接入創意、廣告與購物流程，團隊仍需確認權限與審批
thesis_en: AI enters creative, advertising and shopping workflows, with permissions and approvals to verify
thesis_note: 10篇已覆核新聞，涵蓋創意製作、廣告量度、香港跨境零售及亞太旅遊案例。
thesis_note_en: 10 reviewed stories covering creative production, ad measurement, Hong Kong cross-border retail and APAC tourism.
sections: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Adobe擴展Creative Agent，預覽第三方代理編輯原生專案
items.title_en: Adobe expands Creative Agent and previews third-party editing of native projects
items.summary: Adobe MAX公布Creative Agent擴展至Firefly與Creative Cloud，另展示第三方代理接入原生專案的預覽。
items.summary_en: Adobe MAX announced Creative Agent expansion across Firefly and Creative Cloud, with a preview of third-party agents accessing native projects.
highlights: 預覽涉及Photoshop、Illustrator、Premiere及After Effects。
Adobe亦宣布把CX Enterprise Coworker帶入GenStudio。
highlights_en: The preview covers Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere and After Effects.
Adobe also announced CX Enterprise Coworker for GenStudio.
items.why: 創意團隊可開始評估哪些重複修改適合交給代理，並為原生專案保留版本及審閱紀錄。
items.why_en: Creative teams can assess repeatable edits while keeping project versions and review records.
items.next_step: 選一個可重做的修改任務，列出檔案權限、版本保留及人工審閱要求。
items.next_step_en: Pick one reversible edit and define file permissions, version retention and human review.
items.detail: 本機MCP接入是讓第三方代理與創意工具溝通的預覽。Adobe描述的是代理可在原生專案檔案提出或執行修改的方向，各項工具的正式開放安排仍需逐一確認。團隊評估時可先用複製檔，檢查圖層、字型、色彩及輸出是否符合品牌要求，再決定哪些修改可納入正式製作流程。
items.detail_en: Local MCP integration is a preview of how third-party agents can work with creative tools and edit native projects. Check availability for each application. Start with a copy and validate layers, fonts, colour and output before using the workflow in production.

items.title: 更進新聞：Supermetrics廣告操作加入ChatGPT Ads
items.title_en: Follow-up: Supermetrics adds ChatGPT Ads to campaign management
items.summary: 公司更正後的公告列出七個廣告平台，ChatGPT Ads是較早六平台名單之外的新增項目。
items.summary_en: The corrected release lists seven ad platforms. ChatGPT Ads is the addition to the earlier six-platform list.
highlights: Campaign Management提供可配置審批、權限及預算限制。
公司亦列出變更記錄，供團隊追蹤改動。
highlights_en: Campaign Management offers configurable approvals, permissions and budget limits.
The company also lists a change log for oversight.
items.why: 代理商可在同一工作流程分析和執行廣告調整，實際可用操作仍需按平台查核。
items.why_en: Agencies can link analysis to execution while checking available actions by platform.
items.next_step: 先查閱帳戶可用權限，指定審批人和預算上限，再以非上線活動驗證改動紀錄。
items.next_step_en: Confirm account permissions, approvers and budget limits, then check the log in a non-live campaign.
items.detail: 先前公布的Claude廣告操作涵蓋六個平台。新公告把ChatGPT Ads列入名單，並說明團隊可配置審批、預算限制及權限。各渠道可用的改動類型與預設規則仍要逐項確認。若團隊原有人工核准規則，應先在測試活動查清楚誰能提出、批准與執行改動，以及記錄會保留甚麼資料。
items.detail_en: The earlier Claude announcement covered six platforms. The new release lists ChatGPT Ads and describes configurable approvals, permissions and budget limits. Check supported actions and defaults by channel. Use a test campaign to verify who can propose, approve and execute changes, and what the log records.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.followup: 11月4日版報道Claude廣告操作涵蓋六個平台。這次的新發展是支援名單加入ChatGPT Ads。
items.followup_en: Our November 4 edition covered six platforms for Claude campaign actions. ChatGPT Ads is the new addition.

items.title: MATRADE與HKTVmall推馬來西亞商品專區，指定商品滿額減50元
items.title_en: MATRADE and HKTVmall promote Malaysian goods with a HK$50 threshold offer
items.summary: 合作把馬來西亞食品、保健和生活用品集中到香港網購平台的主題專區。
items.summary_en: The Hong Kong marketplace groups Malaysian food, wellness and lifestyle goods in a dedicated pavilion.
highlights: 主辦方稱專區涵蓋部分清真認證商品。
指定商品消費滿港幣350元，可按活動條款減港幣50元。
highlights_en: The organiser says the selection includes some halal-certified items.
Eligible purchases of HK$350 or more can receive HK$50 off under campaign terms.
items.why: 跨境品牌可藉主題陳列介紹產品來源，並觀察不同價格帶能否組成達標購物籃。
items.why_en: Cross-border brands can tell a provenance story and test which price points make viable baskets.
items.next_step: 按食品、保健及生活類別檢查折扣後毛利，追蹤入店、加購及訂單。
items.next_step_en: Check post-discount margin by category and track visits, basket additions and orders.
items.detail: MATRADE香港辦事處與HKTVmall以主題專區集中展示產品，並用滿額優惠鼓勵顧客探索不同類別。優惠限活動指定商品，商戶評估時應先核對成本、供貨與合資格範圍。若參考相同做法，可分開記錄顧客在專區看到的商品、加購的組合和最後購入品項，以了解主題陳列的作用。
items.detail_en: MATRADE’s Hong Kong office and HKTVmall group products in a themed pavilion and use a spending threshold to encourage browsing. The offer applies to selected items. Review costs, supply and eligibility. Track which products visitors see, add and eventually buy to understand the role of the themed display.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Sitecore推出MarketingIQ，讓品牌跟進AI搜尋中的資料錯誤
items.title_en: Sitecore introduces MarketingIQ for following up on incorrect AI search answers
items.summary: 系統接合Scrunch的觀察與品牌核准資料，可擬議回應並交由行銷人員審批。
items.summary_en: MarketingIQ pairs Scrunch findings with approved brand information and stages proposed responses for marketers.
highlights: 公司以AI答案列出過時價格為例，說明如何擬備修正。
團隊可在發布前修改及批准內容。
highlights_en: Sitecore illustrates the workflow with an AI answer displaying an outdated price.
Teams can edit and approve content before publishing.
items.why: 品牌可把AI答案監察與內容更新交接連起來，清楚知道誰負責核對商品資料。
items.why_en: Brands can connect AI-answer monitoring to content updates and assign ownership of product facts.
items.next_step: 先選一項常被問及的商品資料，記錄錯誤答案、核准來源及更新負責人。
items.next_step_en: Choose one common product question and log the incorrect answer, approved source and update owner.
items.detail: Sitecore把監察結果與內容工作流程放在一起。若AI答案引用舊價格，團隊可用核准資料確認差異，再審閱系統擬備的修正。公告未承諾更新內容後，外部模型會立即更改答案。發布後可用相同問題複查多次，記下答案採用的來源與日期，並將可見度與訂單分開觀察。
items.detail_en: Sitecore connects monitoring with content operations. If an AI answer cites an outdated price, teams can compare it with the approved record and review a proposed correction. The announcement does not promise immediate changes in external answers. Recheck the same queries and track visibility separately from orders.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 內地雙11以AI輔助商品比較、試穿與找優惠
items.title_en: China’s Singles’ Day puts AI product comparison, try-ons and deals in the shopping journey
items.summary: 路透社報道淘寶、天貓及京東等平台的AI購物入口，實際用途包括查詢與比較。
items.summary_en: Reuters reports AI shopping entry points across platforms including Taobao, Tmall and JD, with use cases for queries and comparisons.
highlights: 阿里平台的例子包括虛擬試穿及尋找優惠。
京東稱顧客在雙11透過Dongdong購物助手查詢。
highlights_en: Alibaba examples include virtual try-ons and finding offers.
JD says shoppers used its Dongdong assistant for Singles’ Day advice.
items.why: 消費者可以用自然語言表達需求，品牌的尺寸、適用場景和優惠限制因而更值得寫清楚。
items.why_en: Natural-language queries make clear sizes, use cases and offer limits more useful to shoppers.
items.next_step: 抽查站內常見問題，核對不同商品版本的規格和優惠條款是否一致。
items.next_step_en: Review common questions and check that product variants and offer terms agree across listings.
items.detail: 路透社以各平台功能及消費者訪問呈現雙11的AI購物使用情境，當中包括淘寶用戶試穿衣物，以及京東助手處理商品查詢。這些例子說明可觀察的購物步驟，未能單獨判斷AI對整體支出的影響。品牌可分開記錄商品被發現、顧客查詢及最終下單，找出需要補充的產品資料。
items.detail_en: Reuters uses platform examples and a shopper interview to describe shopping activity, including Taobao clothing try-ons and JD assistant queries. These examples do not establish an effect on overall spend. Track discovery, questions and orders separately to see which product facts are missing.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Kochava推出AIM Essentials，利用歷史資料分析媒體組合
items.title_en: Kochava launches AIM Essentials for media mix analysis using historical data
items.summary: 新方案以逐日事件及媒體支出資料建立行銷組合模型，供團隊檢視預算配置。
items.summary_en: The offering uses daily events and media spend to model the marketing mix and inform budget planning.
highlights: 公司描述的資料範圍是一至兩年。
輸出包括支出反應曲線及投資建議摘要。
highlights_en: The company describes one to two years of daily data inputs.
Outputs include spend-response curves and investment briefs.
items.why: 品牌可用模型提出預算調整假設，再以實驗檢查個別渠道的增量。
items.why_en: Brands can use model estimates to propose budget changes and validate channel incrementality with tests.
items.next_step: 先整理每日媒體支出和業務事件，確認促銷、缺貨及追蹤變動有紀錄。
items.next_step_en: Gather daily media spend and business events, including promotions, stockouts and tracking changes.
items.detail: 行銷組合模型用歷史支出與業務事件估算不同媒體的關聯，供團隊比較預算情境。Kochava稱Essentials已全球開放，較複雜的資料整合與多地區分析另有企業方案。採用前可檢查資料缺口及促銷影響，並要求供應商說明模型假設、估算區間和可用於驗證的實驗設計。
items.detail_en: Marketing mix models use historical spend and business events to compare budget scenarios. Kochava says Essentials is available worldwide and offers a separate enterprise tier for complex integrations and multi-geo analysis. Check data gaps and promotions, and ask for assumptions, uncertainty ranges and a validation design.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Gopuff接入Grok Bot，讓顧客在對話內確認雜貨訂單
items.title_en: Gopuff connects to Grok Bot for in-chat grocery checkout
items.summary: Gopuff稱顧客連接帳戶後，可在同一對話選商品、檢查購物車及結帳。
items.summary_en: Gopuff says customers can link an account, choose items, review the cart and check out in the same conversation.
highlights: 使用前須登入或建立Gopuff帳戶。
公司稱商品選擇按可用庫存組成，顧客仍需確認訂單。
highlights_en: Customers need to sign in or create a Gopuff account.
Gopuff says orders use available inventory and still require customer confirmation.
items.why: 零售團隊可檢查商品資料、庫存和付款確認能否在對話入口保持一致。
items.why_en: Retail teams can check whether product data, inventory and checkout stay consistent in a conversational entry point.
items.next_step: 先畫出一個從商品查詢到訂單確認的流程，標明缺貨、付款及售後責任。
items.next_step_en: Map one journey from product enquiry to order confirmation, including stockouts, payments and support.
items.detail: 對話入口把商品搜尋、購物車和付款確認放在同一流程。Gopuff表示，價格、庫存與配送時段來自自家系統。這對品牌的啟示是，商品內容與實際履約資料要能對上。評估類似接入時，可先檢查缺貨替代、結帳金額及售後入口，再決定是否擴展至更多商品和市場。也可記下付款失敗時如何回復購物車。
items.detail_en: The connector brings product search, cart review and payment confirmation into one flow. Gopuff says prices, stock and delivery windows come from its own systems. Check substitutions, final charges and support before expanding to more products or markets. Record how a shopper can recover the cart after a payment failure.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 首爾旅遊把K-pop宣傳片帶到海外七城戶外版位
items.title_en: Seoul extends its K-pop tourism film to outdoor placements in seven overseas cities
items.summary: 首爾市與首爾觀光財團公布戶外擴展安排，涵蓋紐約、東京、曼谷等市場。
items.summary_en: Seoul and its tourism organisation announced an outdoor expansion including New York, Tokyo and Bangkok.
highlights: 素材由aespa成員Karina、Winter及RIIZE參與。
紐約時代廣場已播放活動精華，各城市按自身檔期安排。
highlights_en: The campaign features aespa’s Karina and Winter alongside RIIZE.
Times Square is showing highlights, with separate schedules by city.
items.why: 旅遊品牌可讓同一內容跨市場延伸，再按所在地的旅遊興趣及語言調整導流入口。
items.why_en: Tourism brands can extend one film across markets and localise the path to trip information.
items.next_step: 按投放城市設獨立的活動入口，分開記錄曝光、行程查詢及後續預訂。
items.next_step_en: Use distinct campaign entry points by city and track exposure, enquiries and bookings separately.
items.detail: 這次公布的是既有旅遊活動向海外戶外媒體延伸。紐約時代廣場和東京澀谷等版位的播放時間不同，其他城市亦按各自檔期安排。目的地團隊若參考做法，可保留辨識度高的主片，再按城市調整語言與旅遊資訊入口，並把戶外接觸後的查詢與最終預訂分開量度。各城市的導流成效宜分開比較。
items.detail_en: The announcement concerns an outdoor extension of an existing tourism campaign. Times Square and Shibuya have different runs, while other cities have their own schedules. Keep a recognisable master film and adapt language and trip information by city. Measure enquiries separately from bookings. Compare referral activity separately by city.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Fireflies公布新版Fred，把會議記錄延伸至跟進工作
items.title_en: Fireflies introduces a new Fred that extends meeting notes into follow-up work
items.summary: 新版把會議記錄、電郵、排程與連接應用納入同一工作環境，部分功能逐步開放。
items.summary_en: The new experience brings together meeting notes, email, scheduling and connected apps, with some capabilities rolling out in stages.
highlights: FredBots可用於定期整理客戶回饋等工作。
公司指Scheduler及Clips會分階段推出。
highlights_en: FredBots can take on recurring tasks such as preparing customer feedback reports.
The company describes a phased rollout for Scheduler and Clips.
items.why: 客戶管理團隊可從會議重點出發，把跟進事項轉成可核對的工作記錄。
items.why_en: Account teams can turn meeting takeaways into traceable follow-up records.
items.next_step: 先以一個非敏感會議測試任務整理，確認負責人、日期及來源能逐項對照。
items.next_step_en: Try a non-sensitive meeting and compare owners, dates and source notes line by line.
items.detail: Fireflies將新版Fred定位為跨應用工作助手，部分功能需要連接既有工具。公司列出可持續執行的工作例子，例如客戶回饋整理。公告另把新版體驗與各項功能的開放時間分開說明。正式連接前，可先限制資料與工具權限，並由團隊核對輸出內容與原會議紀錄是否一致。
items.detail_en: Fireflies positions Fred as a cross-app assistant. Some capabilities require app connections. Recurring customer feedback is one example. The company distinguishes the overall launch from individual rollout dates. Limit permissions first and compare outputs against the meeting record.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Google提醒網站切換CDN時先預熱大促頁面
items.title_en: Google advises warming key promotion pages before a CDN migration
items.summary: Google指出，新CDN的快取未建立時，抓取量增加仍可能讓原站承受額外流量。
items.summary_en: Google says rising crawler traffic can still hit the origin while a new CDN cache is empty.
highlights: 更快的邊緣回應可提高搜尋爬蟲的抓取速度。
Google建議先為高流量及常被抓取的頁面建立快取。
highlights_en: Faster edge responses can increase crawl rate.
Google recommends warming frequently visited and crawled pages first.
items.why: 大促期間改動網站基礎設施，可能同時影響顧客進站和搜尋引擎抓取商品頁。
items.why_en: A migration during a promotion can affect both customer visits and search crawling of product pages.
items.next_step: 與技術團隊列出重點商品和活動網址，切換前受控預熱，切換後查看原站與爬蟲記錄。
items.next_step_en: List priority product and campaign URLs with engineering. Warm them at a controlled pace and review origin and crawler logs.
items.detail: 內容傳遞網路會把可快取內容放到靠近訪客的節點。新節點首次收到未快取的網址時，仍要回到原站取資料。Google建議先處理高流量及常被抓取的頁面，並提醒通用機械人挑戰有機會擋住已驗證的搜尋爬蟲。品牌可把重點頁面、原站負載及抓取狀態列入大促切換清單。
items.detail_en: A content delivery network serves cached material near users. When a new edge receives an uncached URL, it must fetch from the origin. Google recommends warming busy pages and warns that blanket bot challenges can block verified search crawlers. Include key pages, origin load and crawl status in promotion cutover checks.
